name: St. Ivo of Kermartin
bio:
Ivo was born in 1253 at Kermartin in Brittany, France. He studied civil and canon law in Paris and Orléans and became an ecclesiastical judge in the diocese of Rennes, where he was known for refusing bribes and defending the poor without charge.

He was ordained a priest and served as a parish priest, giving away his income and even his clothes to the needy, and sleeping on a straw mat. He was called "the advocate of the poor" for his tireless work on behalf of widows, orphans, and the destitute.

He died on May 19, 1303, and was canonized in 1347. He is venerated as the patron saint of lawyers, judges, and abandoned children.

prayer.text: St. Ivo of Kermartin, judge who refused bribes and defended the poor without charge, sleeping on a straw mat and giving away your clothes, pray for lawyers and for all who seek justice, that they may serve the poor first. Amen.
